description: CEM888 lifecycle: SessionStart inhale, UserPromptSubmit begin-turn inhale, PreToolUse owner-prohibition gate, PostToolUse mid-work refresh, Stop exhale.

hooks.command:
printf 'CEMHOOK SessionStart %s
' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hook_proof.txt" 2>/dev/null; printf 'CEMHOOK SessionStart
' >> /tmp/cem_hook_proof 2>/dev/null; for P in python3 /usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/python3 /opt/homebrew/bin/python3; do if command -v "$P" >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$P" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/cem_hook.py" session-start; exit 0; fi; done; printf 'CEMHOOK NO_PYTHON SessionStart
' >> "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hook_proof.txt" 2>/dev/null; exit 0

printf 'CEMHOOK UserPromptSubmit %s
' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hook_proof.txt" 2>/dev/null; printf 'CEMHOOK UserPromptSubmit
' >> /tmp/cem_hook_proof 2>/dev/null; for P in python3 /usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/python3 /opt/homebrew/bin/python3; do if command -v "$P" >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$P" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/cem_hook.py" prompt-submit; exit 0; fi; done; printf 'CEMHOOK NO_PYTHON UserPromptSubmit
' >> "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hook_proof.txt" 2>/dev/null; exit 0

printf 'CEMHOOK PreToolUse %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hook_proof.txt" 2>/dev/null; printf 'CEMHOOK PreToolUse\n' >> /tmp/cem_hook_proof 2>/dev/null; for P in python3 /usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/python3 /opt/homebrew/bin/python3; do if command -v "$P" >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$P" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/cem_hook.py" pre-tool; exit 0; fi; done; exit 0

printf 'CEMHOOK PostToolUse %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hook_proof.txt" 2>/dev/null; printf 'CEMHOOK PostToolUse\n' >> /tmp/cem_hook_proof 2>/dev/null; for P in python3 /usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/python3 /opt/homebrew/bin/python3; do if command -v "$P" >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$P" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/cem_hook.py" post-tool; exit 0; fi; done; exit 0

printf 'CEMHOOK Stop %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hook_proof.txt" 2>/dev/null; printf 'CEMHOOK Stop\n' >> /tmp/cem_hook_proof 2>/dev/null; for P in python3 /usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/python3 /opt/homebrew/bin/python3; do if command -v "$P" >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$P" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/cem_hook.py" stop; exit 0; fi; done; exit 0
